label: A day of obedience
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: the loser follows the winner for the rest of the day, outside combat.

label: A slot
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: if she wins she books a slot of the commander; if the commander wins she cannot book for a week.

label: A privilege
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: the winner gains standing over the other.

label: Her demand
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: if she wins her open demand is granted; if the commander wins it is dropped with no offence.

label: A token
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: if she wins she gives a token that you wear for a week; if the commander wins she gives one now.

label: A truthful answer
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: the winner asks one question and gets the truth.

label: Her mark
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: if she wins the commander bears her mark for three days.
